purpose: Field registry for the Integration Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen Integration candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name from the frozen input JSON.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines the row identity and preserves the frozen candidate set.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Concise algorithm-family or modeling-family label.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short phrase grounded in the Layer 1 registry and verified method-paper identity.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates transport, graph, probabilistic, geometric, stitching, 3D, multimodal, and batch-correction routes.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input picture for the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level input phrasing rather than commands or parameter lists.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes slices, serial sections, high-resolution samples, spatiotemporal data, multimodal inputs, and single-cell spatial count batches.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Integration.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only the integration, alignment, harmonization, or reconstruction role relevant to this topic.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps cross-topic methods scoped to Integration rather than clustering, deconvolution, or general analysis claims.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to Integration.
fields.fill_rule: Use an object-level phrase such as aligned coordinates, integrated embedding, stitched map, 3D map, or batch-corrected data.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates geometric alignment outputs from latent embeddings, multimodal models, and corrected counts.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen topic set.
fields.fill_rule: Use two to four local alternatives only.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports branch-local comparison without global ranking.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence and avoid runtime-support claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides concise branch-local selection logic.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement.
fields.fill_rule: Use the coarse label from the registry or verified method evidence; do not infer BioHarness runtime readiness.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a branch-local resource gate.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Captures practical constraints without creating execution claims.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to more slices, higher resolution, larger tissue fields, or larger sample batches.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Be conservative unless evidence or method family strongly supports a label.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps flag when high-resolution, atlas-scale, or many-slice workloads require extra audit.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current code-access state.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate access with runtime support.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official documentation location.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when the frozen registry or bounded verification provides a primary code source.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides a traceable source for later engineering review without implying adapter availability.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled source label.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes direct method evidence from benchmark-seeded or synthesized evidence.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note on what is direct evidence and what is Layer 2 synthesized judgment.
fields.fill_rule: Use one to two concise sentences. Mark comparison, burden, risk, and branch placement as synthesized when appropriate.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps evidence strength and uncertainty visible.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one positive conditional sentence. Do not write default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the conditional decision tree.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Main condition where this method should not be the first method read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence and avoid runtime-failure claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents method misuse without claiming execution behavior.

fields.name: Integration Target
fields.definition: Primary Integration target addressed by the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value that best describes the method's role in Integration.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates geometric alignment, representation integration, 3D reconstruction, multimodal integration, and count batch correction.

fields.name: Geometry / Model Cue
fields.definition: Coarse model or geometry mechanism that drives method selection.
fields.fill_rule: Use a concise controlled-style phrase. Use unclear when the public evidence is not enough.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides branch-local mechanism cues without defining Layer 3 contracts.

fields.name: Cross-Sample Cue
fields.definition: Sample relationship or dataset structure that makes the method relevant.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short phrase grounded in method scope.
fields.topic_relevance: Highlights whether the method is for comparable slices, partial overlap, heterogeneous sections, conditions, technologies, temporal series, multimodal data, or batches.

fields.name: Primary Risk Cue
fields.definition: Main scientific or audit caveat that should travel with branch-local method selection.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short caution phrase. Prefer unclear when no specific caveat is justified.
fields.topic_relevance: Makes bias, over-alignment, distortion, model-opacity, modality-imbalance, and code-link trace caveats visible.
